title: Refactor C# Tests to Load Data from Shared JSON Assets
description: Refactor the C# test file at semio/net/Semio.Tests/Tests.cs to load hardcoded test data (GUIDs, design names, expected values, hash strings, glob patterns) from shared JSON asset files in semio/assets/semio/. Test behavior stays in C#, only data moves to assets. Affects: HashTests, DesignQualitySum, KitFilterDesign, FindReplaceableTypesInDesignsTests, Flatten classes.
